limitations: The CLI accepts exactly one local JSON candidate document per invocation.
The CLI does not accept serialized certificates, observations, operational resolutions, or existing same-process bindings.

Because certificates cannot be deserialized, the CLI cannot originate a STRUCTURALLY_INVALID result; fatal-looking results remain unresolved unless a genuine same-process certificate enters through another trusted API boundary.
The CLI does not read OHLCV, detect pivots, discover waves, segment candidates, infer pattern, family, direction, degree, timeframe, or applicability.
The output is a non-authoritative diagnostic snapshot and cannot preserve live object identity or be reloaded as methodology authority.
The CLI writes successful output only to standard output and errors only to standard error; it has no output-file or run-history persistence option.
No multi-candidate, multi-timeframe, lifecycle, ranking, Preferred/Alternative, TradingView, alert, or trading workflow is included.
The validated-family registry remains sealed with zero producers and zero issuances.
SOURCE_DERIVED_BASE_CASE_NOT_FOUND and the P006 source conflict remain unresolved and unchanged.
